name: Iori
message: 「...Alright, that’s good！ Since the distance is too far to step in, try to make your judgments a little faster and more accurate.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You got it！ If they’re far, just go with Origami, and if they’re close, just smack ’em with a punch, right！」
I go around observing the practice and offering advice to the students. It’s been my usual routine lately.
As I look around, I suddenly realize something.

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？ Where’s Ririmu？」
Checking the schedule, she should be training against past Toujinegi using Yorishiro-kun, but I don’t see her anywhere.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, Ririmu-chan？ She said something about her Origami acting up and headed to the workshop a bit ago.」

name: Iori
message: 「Her Origami...？ As far as I checked yesterday, the readings were stable, though.」
The Martial Festival is drawing near; I can’t afford to overlook any equipment trouble.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, I’d better go check on her.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...I’m tellin’ ya！ How does it end up like this！？」
That’s Ririmu’s voice... Did something happen？
I hear a voice berating someone with intense ferocity from the workshop. Ririmu and a Technical Division student are in there.

name: Ririmu
message: 「I asked you to increase the response speed so I could move faster, right！ Why hasn’t anything changed at all？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Why won’t you adjust it the way I told you to？」

name: Technical Division Student
message: 「If you want any more precision than this, we’d have to re-forge the blade—I mean, rebuild it entirely from scratch. That’s just not possible...」

name: Technical Division Student
message: 「Even if we did rebuild it, I don’t think you’d feel the difference. The data shows as much.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It’s not about ‘feeling’ it, okay? I sent you the combat data from my match with Yorishiro-kun earlier, right?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You can see it right there, can’t you？ The numbers aren’t stable at all.」

name: Technical Division Student
message: 「That’s...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Look, you said it yourself at the start. That you were skilled enough to get offers from pro teams.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That’s why I trusted you and paid you to do this. The least you could do is earn your fee.」

name: Technical Division Student
message: 「I-I’m sorry...」
It seems Ririmu isn’t satisfied with the performance of her Origami. So that’s what this is about, despite the readings looking normal.

name: Ririmu
message: 「My response was slow, so I lost to Yorishiro-kun again today. Seriously, give me a break.」

name: Technical Division Student
message: 「I’m doing everything I can… but anything beyond this would require someone at the level of a Saishou, honestly.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So, that’s just a fancy way of saying you’re not skilled enough？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, isn’t that a bit too harsh?」
Feeling sorry for the Technical Division girl, I decide to step in and help.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, Iorin！ Don’t just stand there, say something too~」
The girl from the Technical Division looks at me with an utterly troubled expression.

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, I think she’s doing the absolute best she can within her capabilities.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ehh~, so are you taking her side now, Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, there isn't a single perfect person anywhere in this world. This student from the Technical Division surely has her shortcomings, too.」

name: Iori
message: 「But if we’re talking about that, you have a mountain of shortcomings yourself, Ririmu.」

name: Iori
message: 「I don’t think it’s right to turn a blind eye to your own flaws while attacking others for theirs.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Th-that might be… maybe true, but still~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You say everyone has flaws, but that kind of talk won’t fly once we’ve left the academy, you know.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「If you’re going to be a pro, the results are all that matter in the end. If you don't get results, isn't it only natural to be criticized？」
A pro is defined by results; that might be true.
But even so, that doesn’t give one a free pass to emotionally lash out at others.

name: Iori
message: 「Regardless, let’s call it a day and pick this up another time.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ehh~, what about the adjustments for my Origami！？」

name: Iori
message: 「It’s fine, really. Come on, Ririmu, let’s go.」
I push Ririmu from behind to get her moving, then speak to the Technical Division girl.

name: Iori
message: 「I apologize for Ririmu earlier. Please, don’t take it to heart.」

name: Technical Division Student
message: 「O-oh, yes… thank you very much…」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait, why is it being made out like I’m the bad guy here? That doesn’t make sense at all~！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes, yes, let’s go~」
I pull Ririmu by the arm and lead her outside.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, hey~, you’re strong, Sensei~」
And so, I dragged Ririmu all the way back to the classroom.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh, I'm so pissed off！ How did it turn out like this?！」
Even after getting back, Ririmu's anger hadn't subsided.

name: Ririmu
message: 「I mean, sure, I got a little worked up too~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But if you're paying someone and they don't do a job you're satisfied with, it's totally normal to get mad, right！」

name: Iori
message: 「I get where you're coming from, but calm down.」

name: Iori
message: 「Like I said earlier, everyone has their own shortcomings.」

name: Iori
message: 「Imperfect people like that work together and try their best to accomplish all kinds of things.」

name: Iori
message: 「That's what this human society we live in is all about.」

name: Iori
message: 「We mustn't lose sight of that fundamental principle—that we achieve things by working together.」
There are people out there who forget that, and do nothing but hunt for other people's flaws just to pick them apart.
I don't want Ririmu to become that kind of person.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, well, I'm paying that girl a fee in exchange for lending me her help, you know？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「When you talk about 'working together,' Sensei, that's obviously one way of doing it too, isn't it？」

name: Iori
message: 「W-Well, that's true.」
This is Japan, a capitalist society, so naturally I have to concede that point.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Then if you take money for a job, botch it, and get yelled at by the client, isn't that just reaping what you sow？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, people aren't motivated by money alone. You won't get the best results doing things your way.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Keeping up your motivation is part of being a pro, isn't it? Why is that something I have to worry about?」

name: Iori
message: 「U-Uhh...」
Ririmu really is naturally sharp.
She properly understands what I'm saying, and then comes right back at me with a philosophy all her own.

name: Asahi
message: 「*Sigh*... What a despicable attitude.」
With that, Asahi, who had been listening nearby, stands up.

name: Asahi
message: 「...I have been listening quietly for some time now, and all you do is spout selfish rationalizations.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Do you have no sense of human compassion whatsoever？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huuuh？ Why the hell do I have to take that from you？」

name: Asahi
message: 「You aren't even aware that you're only able to exist here because of the consideration shown by the people around you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yet, you don't show any consideration for those around you in return. In short, you are exploiting the kindness of others.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I don't have a clue what you're talking about.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Heh, I suppose so. That was probably a bit too complex for a monkey to understand.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You, seriously, cut the crap already...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「The one who needs to cut it out is you, Ririmu-san.」

name: Asahi
message: 「You selfishly exploit Iori-sensei's kindness and consideration, all while brandishing your own crude logic to cause him grief.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I am thoroughly sick of that side of you.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, yeah? Then I'm gonna have my say, too.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That whole thing you do where you just naturally talk down to people and mutter your self-righteous crap? It makes me super pissed off！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「What？ What is it？ You think you're so high and mighty？ You're not exactly in a position to be lecturing me.」
Asahi and Ririmu stand up and glare at one another.

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, both of you, that's enough...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No way. Not even if you ask, Teach. Today, there's no way I'm letting this slide. I need to knock some sense into this chick.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Heh, the smallest dogs always bark the loudest, don't they?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Your brother, Kuki Takahisa, was it？ I fought him in the Yorishiro-kun simulator the other day, you know.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「To put it bluntly, he's a total scrub.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...What did you just say？」
The air in the room freezes due to the killing intent leaking from Asahi.

name: Ririmu
message: 「I'll say it as many times as you want. Kuki Takahisa wasn't all that impressive compared to other Toujinegi.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「And you're the same—not that impressive at all.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...I see. Understood.」

name: Asahi
message: 「It seems I'll have to knock a blade into that empty head of yours just once...！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Bring it on, let's see you try...!」
Both of them reach for their Origami. Tenju is activated, and the tension in the room spikes instantly.

name: Momiji
message: 「Wait, Sensei... what do we do about this！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「This is bad, Sensei, this is really bad!」
Good grief, so it finally came to this. I had a feeling a day like this might come.

name: Iori
message: 「Both of you, take your hands off the Origami.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Sorry, that’s impossible now.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I’m sorry, Iori-sensei. I’m at my limit as well.」

name: Iori
message: 「...I told you to take your hands off, didn't I？」
I stomped my foot down. The ground shook, and the ceiling lights flickered.

name: Momiji
message: 「Whoa... that scared me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Se, Sensei, there’s a crack in the floor where you’re standing...」

name: Iori
message: 「Now, Asahi, Ririmu. Let go.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「R, roger...」
The two girls pulled their hands away from the Origami, and the Tenju was released.

name: Iori
message: 「Well then.」

name: Iori
message: 「You are not allowed to use Tenju in the classroom. It should be clearly written in the academy rules, shouldn't it?」

name: Iori
message: 「Those who violate this will be suspended, or in the worst case, expelled. You won't get off with a light punishment.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I am sorry, Iori-sensei. I was reckless...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Sorry I triggered the Tenju, my bad.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But still, I’m not convinced. I mean, it’s the Kijo’s fault for making fun of me.」

name: Asahi
message: 「You...！ Do you not know the meaning of the word 'repent'？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You’re the one who needs to repent!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hey Sensei, isn't this never going to end...？」
Yeah, I think so too.

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, Ririmu, I understand how you both feel.」

name: Iori
message: 「But I can't let the two of you keep quarreling here like this.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Even if you say that, come on！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I can't just let this rest...！」

name: Iori
message: 「Then why don't we have a head-to-head sparring session！！」
Both of their eyes go wide.

name: Iori
message: 「Fighting is one form of mutual understanding, too. If you've got something to get across, let's settle it in a match.」

name: Iori
message: 「Just unleash everything you're feeling on your opponent there.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...I like the sound of that. Let's do it, Kijo.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Understood. I accept your challenge.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ooooh, sounds fun！ Sensei, I wanna watch！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Setsugekka, that's inappropriate.」

name: Iori
message: 「I don't mind at all.」
If they each think they're in the right, I want them to put on a fight they wouldn't be ashamed for anyone to see.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright then, everyone, let's head to the training ground！」
